Hamiltoniano baja al QPU y abre canales a Manos y Juicio\n2. Manos → QPU (DD/fase)\n3. Reflejos → QPU (layout MIS)\n4. QPU → Workload → Observable (+ QPU → Observable)\n5. Workload → Reflejos (contexto de ejecución)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"2bdb83f6-24d8-4a2c-991d-ed7045d11ec6","cell_type":"code","source":"import json, math\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nOUT = Path(\"outputs_canva_topo\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nRNG = np.random.default_rng(42)\n\nclass Regime(str, Enum):\n    ESTABLE = \"ESTABLE\"\n    INESTABLE = \"INESTABLE\"\n    CONFLICTO = \"CONFLICTO\"\n\nclass CausalRole(str, Enum):\n    CAUSA_DIRECTA = \"CAUSA_DIRECTA\"\n    INDICADOR = \"INDICADOR\"\n    COMBINACION = \"COMBINACION\"\n    NULO = \"NULO\"\n\nclass Intervention(str, Enum):\n    HOLD = \"HOLD\"\n    REMAP = \"REMAP\"\n    DD_CONDITIONAL = \"DD_CONDITIONAL\"\n    DD_ALWAYS = \"DD_ALWAYS\"\n\ndef HIS(h_id, h_re, eps=1e-8):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < eps else max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d)\n\nprint(\"OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.374228Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.374924Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.385527Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.374895Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.384320Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":46},{"id":"0eba6812-b0cd-4b2e-a606-483a0b49fc8f","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 1. HAMILTONIANO (raiz del diagrama)\n# ============================================================\n@dataclass\nclass HamiltonianSpec:\n    n: int\n    weights: List[float]  # acoplos ZZ camino\n    h_ideal: float\n\n    def label(self) -> str:\n        return f\"IsingPath(n={self.n}, terms={len(self.weights)})\"\n\ndef build_hamiltonian(n: int = 8) -> HamiltonianSpec:\n    weights = [-0.5] * (n - 1)\n    # <H>_ideal de referencia (proxy estable para evaluacion)\n    h_ideal = 1.5\n    return HamiltonianSpec(n=n, weights=weights, h_ideal=h_ideal)\n\nH = build_hamiltonian(8)\nprint(\"Hamiltoniano:\", H.label(), \"H_ideal=\", H.h_ideal)\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.387853Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.388524Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.417989Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.388495Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.416824Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Hamiltoniano: IsingPath(n=8, terms=7) H_ideal= 1.5\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":47},{"id":"e1c4ee68-7625-4d7c-822b-798415da6a18","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 2. QPU / Qubits (centro)\n# ============================================================\n@dataclass\nclass QPUState:\n    n: int\n    cycle: int\n    t1: Dict[int, float]\n    t2: Dict[int, float]\n    readout: Dict[int, float]\n    detuning: Dict[int, float]\n    gate2q: Dict[int, float]\n    coupling_map: List[Tuple[int, int]]\n    # escritos por Manos / Reflejos\n    layout: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dd_on: bool = False\n    dd_seq: str = \"NONE\"\n    phase_vz: float = 0.0\n\ndef evolve_qpu(n: int, cycle: int, drift_qubits: List[int]) -> QPUState:\n    t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\n    for q in range(n):\n        if q in drift_qubits:\n            t2[q] = max(25.0, 155.0 - 4.5 * cycle)\n        else:\n            t2[q] = 150.0 + float(RNG.normal(0, 3))\n        t1[q] = max(30.0, 0.7 * t2[q] + float(RNG.normal(0, 2)))\n        readout[q] = 0.01 + (0.03 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 30.0)\n        detuning[q] = (-27.0 if t2[q] > 100 else -22.0) + float(RNG.normal(0, 0.3))\n        gate2q[q] = 0.006 + (0.01 if q in drift_qubits else 0.0) * (cycle / 20.0)\n    return QPUState(n, cycle, t1, t2, readout, detuning, gate2q,\n                    [(i, i+1) for i in range(n-1)],\n                    layout=list(range(n)))\n\ndef qpu_health(qpu: QPUState) -> Dict[int, float]:\n    h = {}\n    for q in range(qpu.n):\n        f = max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t2[q]/150.0)*0.35\n        f += max(0.0, 1.0 - qpu.t1[q]/100.0)*0.15\n        f += min(1.0, qpu.readout[q]/0.05)*0.25\n        f += min(1.0, abs(qpu.detuning[q])/30.0)*0.10\n        f += min(1.0, qpu.gate2q[q]/0.02)*0.15\n        h[q] = float(np.clip(1.0 - f, 0, 1))\n    return h\n\ndef qpu_friction(qpu: QPUState, layout: Optional[List[int]] = None) -> float:\n    qs = layout if layout else list(range(qpu.n))\n    health = qpu_health(qpu)\n    return float(1.0 - np.mean([health[q] for q in qs]))\n\nprint(\"QPU OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.419449Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.419795Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.442647Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.419756Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.441877Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"QPU OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":48},{"id":"a828a960-72e1-4256-ad8d-18c362b57ad0","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 3. REFLEJOS ← Workload + Observable  |  → QPU (layout)\n# ============================================================\nclass Reflejos:\n    def __init__(self, n):\n        self.n = n\n        self.last_his = 1.0\n        self.last_workload_ok = True\n\n    def select(self, qpu: QPUState, observable_feedback: Optional[dict] = None,\n               workload_feedback: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:\n        # feedback rojo desde Observable: si HIS bajo, penalizar qubits del layout anterior\n        health = qpu_health(qpu)\n        if observable_feedback is not None:\n            self.last_his = float(observable_feedback.get(\"HIS\", self.last_his))\n            if self.last_his < 0.85 and qpu.layout:\n                for q in qpu.layout[: max(1, len(qpu.layout)//2)]:\n                    health[q] = max(0.0, health[q] - 0.08)\n        if workload_feedback is not None:\n            self.last_workload_ok = bool(workload_feedback.get(\"ok\", True))\n\n        ranked = sorted(health.keys(), key=lambda q: health[q], reverse=True)\n        edges = {(min(a,b), max(a,b)) for a,b in qpu.coupling_map}\n        selected, forbidden, avoided = [], set(), 0\n        for q in ranked:\n            if q in forbidden:\n                avoided += 1\n                continue\n            selected.append(q)\n            for a, b in edges:\n                if a == q: forbidden.add(b)\n                elif b == q: forbidden.add(a)\n            if len(selected) >= self.n:\n                break\n        for q in ranked:\n            if len(selected) >= self.n:\n                break\n            if q not in selected:\n                selected.append(q)\n        selected = selected[: self.n]\n        score = float(np.mean([health[q] for q in selected]))\n        # escribe layout en QPU\n        qpu.layout = list(selected)\n        return {\"selected\": selected, \"score\": score, \"edges_avoided\": avoided,\n                \"fed_his\": self.last_his}\n\nprint(\"Reflejos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.443916Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.444294Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.467554Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.444270Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.466586Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Reflejos OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":49},{"id":"093ab5b9-2499-4fcd-b357-82c6e2999101","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 4. JUICIO ← Hamiltoniano + QPU + Observable  |  plan → Manos\n# ============================================================\nclass Juicio:\n    def __init__(self, thr=0.92):\n        self.thr = thr\n        self.prev_his = 1.0\n\n    def decide(self, H: HamiltonianSpec, qpu: QPUState, morph: dict,\n               observable_feedback: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:\n        friction = qpu_friction(qpu, morph[\"selected\"])\n        # regimen simple desde friccion\n        if friction < 0.28:\n            regime = Regime.ESTABLE\n        elif friction < 0.45:\n            regime = Regime.INESTABLE\n        else:\n            regime = Regime.CONFLICTO\n\n        do_a = max(0.0, self.thr - morph[\"score\"]) * 0.6\n        do_z = friction * 1\n        if regime == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            do_z += 0.25\n        elif regime == Regime.INESTABLE:\n            do_z += 0.12\n\n        # feedback Observable → Juicio (flecha roja): si HIS cayo, priorizar causa latente\n        if observable_feedback is not None:\n            his_now = float(observable_feedback.get(\"HIS\", self.prev_his))\n            if his_now < self.prev_his - 0.04:\n                do_z += 0.14\n            self.prev_his = his_now\n\n        # Hamiltoniano informa escala de ganancia esperada\n        scale_H = abs(H.h_ideal) / 1.5\n\n        c, z = abs(do_a) >= 0.20, abs(do_z) >= 0.20\n        if c and z: role = CausalRole.COMBINACION\n        elif c: role = CausalRole.CAUSA_DIRECTA\n        elif z: role = CausalRole.INDICADOR\n        else: role = CausalRole.NULO\n\n        if regime == Regime.ESTABLE and morph[\"score\"] >= self.thr:\n            inter, reason = Intervention.HOLD, \"estable_hold\"\n            gain = 0.0\n        elif role == CausalRole.INDICADOR or regime == Regime.CONFLICTO:\n            inter, reason = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"latent_dd\"\n            gain = float(do_z) * scale_H\n        elif do_a >= do_z:\n            inter, reason = Intervention.REMAP, \"candidate_remap\"\n            gain = float(do_a) * scale_H\n        else:\n            inter, reason = Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, \"combined_dd\"\n            gain = float(do_z) * scale_H\n\n        return {\n            \"role\": role, \"intervention\": inter, \"targets\": list(morph[\"selected\"]),\n            \"expected_gain\": gain, \"reason\": reason, \"do_a\": do_a, \"do_z\": do_z,\n            \"regime\": regime,\n        }\n\nprint(\"Juicio OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.469823Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.470354Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.495842Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.470319Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.495005Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Juicio OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":50},{"id":"10f34b98-9098-42a5-8cad-853275719f1e","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 5. MANOS ← Hamiltoniano (contexto) + Juicio  |  → QPU\n# ============================================================\nclass Manos:\n    def act(self, H: HamiltonianSpec, qpu: QPUState, plan: dict) -> dict:\n        dd = plan[\"intervention\"] in (Intervention.DD_CONDITIONAL, Intervention.DD_ALWAYS)\n        seq = \"CPMG\" if dd else \"NONE\"\n        tg = plan[\"targets\"] or list(range(qpu.n))\n        phase = float(np.mean([qpu.detuning.get(q, 0.0) for q in tg])) * 1e-3\n        # Hamiltoniano no cambia la secuencia; contextualiza coste de fase vs profundidad\n        if abs(H.h_ideal) > 2.0 and dd:\n            seq = \"XY4\"  # mas robusto si el observable es \"pesado\"\n        qpu.dd_on = dd\n        qpu.dd_seq = seq\n        qpu.phase_vz = phase\n        if not qpu.layout:\n            qpu.layout = list(tg)\n        return {\"dd_applied\": dd, \"sequence\": seq, \"phase_vz\": phase,\n                \"probe_state\": \"degraded\" if dd else \"stable\", \"layout\": list(qpu.layout)}\n\nprint(\"Manos OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.497283Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.497679Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.515896Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.497655Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.515116Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Manos OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":51},{"id":"b8ed5aaf-3091-4978-82c9-841bc1097c8c","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 6. WORKLOAD (QPU/Aer) y OBSERVABLE\n# ============================================================\ndef run_workload(H: HamiltonianSpec, qpu: QPUState, actuated: bool) -> dict:\n    if actuated:\n        layout = list(qpu.layout) if qpu.layout else list(range(qpu.n))\n        dd, phase = qpu.dd_on, abs(qpu.phase_vz)\n    else:\n        layout = list(range(qpu.n))\n        dd, phase = False, 0.0\n    fr = qpu_friction(qpu, layout)\n    mit = 1.0\n    if dd:\n        mit *= 0.62\n    if phase > 0:\n        mit *= max(0.85, 1.0 - min(0.1, phase))\n    h_real = H.h_ideal * (1.0 - min(0.95, fr * mit))\n    his = HIS(H.h_ideal, h_real)\n    return {\n        \"ok\": True,\n        \"actuated\": actuated,\n        \"layout\": layout,\n        \"dd\": dd,\n        \"friction\": fr,\n        \"mitigation\": mit,\n        \"H_ideal\": H.h_ideal,\n        \"H_real\": h_real,\n        \"HIS\": his,\n    }\n\nprint(\"Workload/Observable OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.517311Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.517680Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.538102Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.517646Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T06:28:47.537057Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Workload/Observable OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":52},{"id":"579a5819-3d7c-4cda-84a7-936a151ea4bd","cell_type":"code","source":"# ============================================================\n# 7. Bucle segun diagrama Canva\n# ============================================================\nCONFIG = {\"n_cycles\": 30, \"his_floor\": 0.15, \"drift_qubits\": [1, 3, 5, 6]}\nH = build_hamiltonian(8)\nreflejos = Reflejos(H.n)\njuicio = Juicio(thr=0.92)\nmanos = Manos()\n\nobs_fb = None          # Observable → Juicio / Reflejos\nwl_fb = None           # Workload → Reflejos\nhist = []\nbreak_base = break_eqg = None\n\nfor c in range(CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"]):\n    # centro: QPU evoluciona\n    qpu = evolve_qpu(H.n, c, CONFIG[\"drift_qubits\"])\n\n    # Reflejos usa feedback previo (Observable + Workload) y escribe layout en QPU\n    morph = reflejos.select(qpu, observable_feedback=obs_fb, workload_feedback=wl_fb)\n\n    # Juicio usa Hamiltoniano + estado QPU (via morph/friction) + feedback Observable\n    plan = juicio.decide(H, qpu, morph, observable_feedback=obs_fb)\n\n    # Manos usa Hamiltoniano + plan; escribe DD/fase en QPU\n    hands = manos.act(H, qpu, plan)\n\n    # Workload sobre el mismo QPU: baseline vs actuado\n    wl_base = run_workload(H, qpu, actuated=False)\n    wl_eqg = run_workload(H, qpu, actuated=True)\n\n    # Observable canal (salida + feedback)\n    obs_fb = {\"HIS\": wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], \"H_real\": wl_eqg[\"H_real\"], \"H_ideal\": H.h_ideal}\n    wl_fb = {\"ok\": True, \"HIS\": wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], \"layout\": wl_eqg[\"layout\"]}\n\n    if break_base is None and wl_base[\"HIS\"] <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_base = c\n    if break_eqg is None and wl_eqg[\"HIS\"] <= CONFIG[\"his_floor\"]:\n        break_eqg = c\n\n    hist.append({\n        \"cycle\": c,\n        \"hamiltonian\": H.label(),\n        \"reflexes\": morph,\n        \"judgment\": {**plan, \"role\": plan[\"role\"].value,\n                     \"intervention\": plan[\"intervention\"].value,\n                     \"regime\": plan[\"regime\"].value},\n        \"hands\": hands,\n        \"workload_base\": wl_base,\n        \"workload_eqg\": wl_eqg,\n        \"observable\": obs_fb,\n    })\n    if c % 5 == 0 or c == CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - 1:\n        print(\"c=%02d  HIS_b=%.3f  HIS_e=%.3f  mit=%.2f  %s  dd=%s  fedHIS=%.3f\" % (\n            c, wl_base[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"HIS\"], wl_eqg[\"mitigation\"],\n            plan[\"intervention\"].value, hands[\"dd_applied\"], morph[\"fed_his\"]))\n\nextra = None\nif break_base is not None:\n    extra = (break_eqg - break_base) if break_eqg is not None else CONFIG[\"n_cycles\"] - break_base\nhis_b = [h[\"workload_base\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist]\nhis_e = [h[\"workload_eqg\"][\"HIS\"] for h in hist]\nprint(\"\\nbreak_base=%s break_eqg=%s extra=%s\" % (break_base, break_eqg, extra))\nprint(\"mean HIS base=%.4f eqg=%.4f Δ=%.4f\" % (\n
